name: univeros/orion
description: Orion as a Univeros module: one line in config/modules.php gives the host Orion on its Cycle connection, the migration, the orion:* commands and the doctor checks

suggest.orion-search/polaris: With univeros/polaris, each request's tenant is its token's active organization
suggest.univeros/doctor: The seven Orion checks join bin/altair doctor, with --fix where it is safe
suggest.univeros/messaging: The drain runs on the bus worker after each commit instead of in the request
suggest.univeros/observability: Orion's counters and the outbox lag gauge go to the framework Meter
suggest.laminas/laminas-diactoros: PSR-17 factories for the search: endpoints when the container binds none (the skeleton ships it)
